definitions.explanation: To agree to take or allow something.

definitions.gloss: to accept, to come to terms with
definitions.explanation: To acknowledge and accept a situation or reality.

notes:
{受|う}け{入|い}れる means to accept, receive, or come to terms with something.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Compound of ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ + ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧.

TWO MAIN USAGES:
1. To accept/receive (proposals, people): ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れる
2. To accept/come to terms with: ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れる

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れ：22149_ukeire⟧: acceptance (noun form)
- ⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れ：22149_ukeire⟧⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧: reception preparation
- ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept refugees
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept conditions
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept criticism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受|う}け{入|い}れる: to accept (actively agree to)
- ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive (more passive)
- ⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧: to take in and face something (news, criticism) without necessarily agreeing to it
- ⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to decline — the everyday opposite of {受|う}け{入|い}れる
